# Code of Conduct

Bullet follows the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Standards

- Be respectful and welcoming regardless of experience or background.
- Critique code and ideas, never people. Harassment, insults, and personal attacks are not tolerated.
- Never share private data, accounts, or credentials.
- Do not use Bullet or community spaces to harass players, bypass anti-cheat, or discuss account trading.

## Scope & Reporting

Applies across GitHub (issues, PRs, discussions) and the [Bullet Discord](https://discord.gg/e2dH2nUjd9).
Report violations privately via [isllan.dev](https://isllan.dev/) or a [private security advisory](https://github.com/Isllanrx/Bullet/security/advisories/new). Maintainers handle reports confidentially and may warn, suspend, or ban violators.
